simple.prompt: ___ does the quarterly shareholder conference begin?
simple.explanation: Untuk menanyakan waktu jam spesifik, gunakan question word 'What time' atau 'When'.

simple.prompt: ___ is in charge of reviewing customer refund requests this week?
simple.explanation: 'Who' digunakan untuk menanyakan subjek orang pelaku aksi ('siapa yang bertanggung jawab').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya Yes/No sederhana dengan auxiliary verb 'Do'.
simple.targetSentence: Do you prefer tea or coffee?
simple.explanation: Rumus: Do + Subject (you) + Base verb (prefer) + Object (tea or coffee)?

simple.prompt: ___ is the nearest subway station located?
simple.explanation: 'Where' digunakan untuk menanyakan lokasi atau tempat fisik.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya dengan kata tanya 'Why'.
simple.targetSentence: Why is the office closed today?
simple.explanation: Wh-word (Why) + to be (is) + Subject (the office) + Adjective (closed) + Time (today)?
hints: Inversikan to be 'is' sebelum subjek 'the office'.

simple.prompt: ___ of these two software licenses did your team purchase?
simple.explanation: Gunakan 'Which' ketika memilih dari sekumpulan opsi pilihan yang terbatas/spesifik ('these two licenses').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya untuk menanyakan durasi waktu dengan 'How long'.
simple.targetSentence: How long does the training session last?
simple.explanation: Question phrase (How long) + Auxiliary (does) + Subject (the training session) + Base verb (last)?

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog dengan pertanyaan klarifikasi alasan yang tepat.
dialogue: ___ did you decide to reschedule the product launch?
Because our beta testers discovered critical bugs yesterday.
intermediate.explanation: Jawaban yang diawali 'Because' (karena) menjawab pertanyaan alasan 'Why'.

intermediate.prompt: ___ often does the internal audit committee inspect inventory logs?
intermediate.explanation: 'How often' adalah frasa tanya untuk menanyakan frekuensi pengulangan (seberapa sering).

intermediate.prompt: Notice the difference: '___ happened at the executive meeting?' (Subject question).
intermediate.explanation: Ketika kata tanya 'What/Who' berfungsi sebagai SUBJEK kalimat, TIDAK menggunakan auxiliary 'did/do/does', melainkan langsung diikuti kata kerja: 'What happened?', bukan 'What did happen?'.
hints: Pertanyaan ini menanyakan subjek pelaku peristiwa.

intermediate.prompt: Susun subject question tanpa auxiliary verb.
intermediate.explanation: Subject question: 'Who' bertindak sebagai subjek, langsung diikuti past verb 'wrote' dan objek.

intermediate.prompt: Sebaliknya, pada Object question: 'Who ___ at the networking dinner yesterday?'
intermediate.explanation: Ketika subjeknya adalah 'you' dan 'Who' adalah objek yang ditemui (Object question), wajib menggunakan auxiliary inversi: 'did you meet'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun pertanyaan dengan preposisi di akhir (preposition stranding).
intermediate.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris lisan alami, preposisi diletakkan di akhir: Who + are + you + waiting for?

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog tanya jawab tentang biaya.
dialogue: ___ does the annual software subscription cost?
It costs twelve hundred dollars per user.
intermediate.explanation: Untuk menanyakan harga atau biaya (jumlah uang), gunakan frasa 'How much'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan umum penataan kalimat tanya tidak langsung (indirect / embedded question).
complex.draft: Could you please tell me where is the conference hall?
options: Could you please tell me where the conference hall is?
Could you please tell me where does the conference hall locate?
Could you please tell me where is the conference hall located?
complex.explanation: Pada indirect question (kalimat tanya yang disematkan setelah 'Could you tell me...'), urutan kata KEMBALI ke urutan pernyataan normal (Subject + Verb: 'where the conference hall is'), BUKAN bentuk tanya inversi ('where is...').
hints: Indirect question tidak menggunakan inversi Verb-Subject.
Urutannya: Wh-word + Subject (the conference hall) + Verb (is).

complex.prompt: I wonder why ___ to sign the nondisclosure agreement.
complex.explanation: Setelah klausa pernyataan 'I wonder why...', klausa bawahan menggunakan urutan subjek + kata kerja biasa: 'they refused'.
Embedded question setelah 'Do you know...': susunan harus 'Subject + Verb', tanpa auxiliary 'does'.

complex.prompt: Susun indirect question yang santun dan formal.
complex.targetSentence: Do you know how much this will cost?
complex.explanation: Do you know + question phrase (how much) + Subject (this) + Verb (will cost)?
hints: Urutan klausa: how much this will cost.

complex.prompt: Koreksi pertanyaan formal dengan preposisi depan (fronted preposition).
complex.draft: To whom did you submitted the revised specifications?
options: To whom did you submit the revised specifications?
To who did you submit the revised specifications?
To whom submitted you the revised specifications?
complex.explanation: Setelah auxiliary 'did', kata kerja wajib kembali ke bentuk dasar 'submit', bukan 'submitted'. Dalam gaya formal, preposisi di depan memakai objek pronoun 'whom' ('To whom').
hints: Setelah auxiliary 'did', verb kembali ke bentuk dasar 'submit'.

complex.prompt: Negative questions often express surprise or confirmation: '___ received the tracking confirmation yet?'
complex.explanation: Negative question 'Haven't you received...?' digunakan untuk menyatakan keheranan atau meminta konfirmasi atas ekspektasi pembicara.
hints: Pertanyaan negatif untuk menyatakan rasa heran.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog negosiasi dengan indirect question tingkat lanjut.
dialogue: Certainly. The cost covers 24/7 dedicated enterprise support.
options: what does this service fee include
complex.explanation: Setelah 'Can you explain...', klausa berbentuk indirect: Wh-word (what) + Subject (this service fee) + Verb (includes).
